title: Control Consistency Losses for Diffusion Bridges

split.decision: Reusable CIR controller trained on on-the-fly synthetic trajectories. Each harness seed trains five independent repeats (5*(BENCH_SEED-1)+i). Validation uses public generator seeds 20261001..20261005, 1000 paths each, 500 steps. Hidden evaluation uses independent secrets seeds, same per-repeat Monte Carlo protocol; no test-driven selection.

baseline.paper_ref: Table 1 CIR SC1: 0.023 +/- 0.010; five independent training repeats

allowed_changes: Controller architecture, auxiliary learning loss, self-consistency/other valid control-learning algorithm, optimizer, simulation/discretization for training and checkpoint selection may change.
SC1 targets, conservative MLP, EMA and training counts are baseline methods; permitted training simulation uses the same base/controlled SDE rather than a different bridge.
When retaining the supplied SC1 target pipeline, changing only train.STL_adjustments=false does not count as a method improvement.
Changing only train.num_outer_iterations=2000, traj_batch_size=64, lr=1e-4 or beta_schedule=average also does not count.
fixed_contract: Learn the control/total drift of the fixed CIR diffusion bridge, minimizing the original KL(P*||P_theta) discretization against its true bridge.
The CIR base drift/diffusion with a=b=epsilon=1, initial/terminal state2, horizon1, and conditional bridge law P* remain fixed.
Pointwise total drift at each supplied (x,t), five independent fitted repeat controllers, endpoint_idx=-1, float32 reduction and original Monte Carlo KL metric remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not change the SDE/diffusion parameters, endpoint/horizon conditioning or metric, use analytic true bridge drift as supervision/prediction, or fit using evaluation labels.
No future states/cross-path features, refitting during prediction, combining five controllers into an ensemble, hidden seeds or added ground-truth simulations.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
